schema:
CREATE TABLE USERS (USER_ID INT PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR(50));
CREATE TABLE LOGINS (USER_ID INT, LOGIN_DATE DATE);
correct_query: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.NAME FROM USERS U INNER JOIN (SELECT USER_ID FROM LOGINS GROUP BY USER_ID HAVING MIN(LOGIN_DATE) >= '2022-01-01' AND MAX(LOGIN_DATE) <= '2022-12-31') L ON U.USER_ID = L.USER_ID

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.NAME FROM USERS U JOIN LOGINS L ON U.USER_ID = L.USER_ID GROUP BY U.USER_ID HAVING SUM(IF(LOGIN_DATE BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-12-31', 0, 1)) = 0
